incident.observation: The egress boundary denied CONNECT github.com:443 after the Hermes TUI gateway startup banner and before task execution.
incident.productionImpact: The connection was denied. No GitHub request completed, no task ran, and the host was returned to its verified dark state.

attribution.initiatingSubsystem: Hermes TUI gateway automatic startup update checker
basis: The exact installed image source calls prefetch_update_check unconditionally during gateway startup.
The exact installed image implementation launches a background thread that calls check_for_updates.
The update path invokes git ls-remote against the same github.com authority observed in the denied boundary event.
The denied event occurred immediately after the gateway startup banner and before execution activity.

remediation.strategy: Patch the derivative Hermes runtime image at build time so prefetch_update_check returns without creating a thread or performing network activity.

remainingProof: The rebuilt derivative image must pass its direct verifier, a zero-work rehearsal with zero unexplained allowed or denied controls, and the independently reviewed bounded live gates before this incident is considered operationally closed.
